name: Pin & Pan Style (Combat, Style)
body:
You are a real battle chef, using your tools as weapons or the other way round with the same ease.

Prerequisites(s): Proficiency with battle pan and battle pin, Shield Proficiency, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus (battle pan or battle pin).

Benefit(s): While wielding a battle pin in one hand and a battle pan in the other, you do not suffer any penalties for fighting with two weapons.
